class.name: AnimationNodeMotionMatching
class.brief_description: Animation node that selects clips with motion matching.
class.description: [AnimationNodeMotionMatching] runs a pose search over a [CgameMotionMatchingDatabase] every [member search_interval] seconds and plays the best matching clip from the matching time, crossfading over [member blend_time] when it jumps. If the best match is simply the next frame of the playing clip, playback continues without a jump. Clips are mapped to animations of the [AnimationMixer] through [member clip_animations]; a clip without an entry uses an animation with the same name. The query is controlled with the tree parameters [code]velocity[/code], [code]facing[/code], [code]desired_velocity[/code], [code]desired_facing[/code], [code]left_foot[/code], [code]right_foot[/code], [code]left_foot_velocity[/code] and [code]right_foot_velocity[/code], or by writing a complete [PackedFloat32Array] of 24 floats to [code]features[/code]. The read-only parameters [code]current_clip[/code] and [code]last_cost[/code] report the selection. [codeblock] var mm := AnimationNodeMotionMatching.new() mm.database = CgameMotionMatchingDatabase.build_default_database() animation_tree.tree_root = mm animation_tree["parameters/desired_velocity"] = Vector2(0, 3) [/codeblock]

members.member: Crossfade duration in seconds when the search jumps to another clip or time.
Maps clip names to animation names. Missing entries use the clip name.
Only clips carrying all of these tags are searched.
If [code]true[/code], searches all frames instead of using the index. Results are identical; this is for debugging.
